trends.title: Parent snapping/yelling at children - inability to stop
trends.quote: I snap/yell at my kids when I'm frustrated and I don't know how to stop. I try SO HARD. But when I get frustrated/at the end of my rope, I yell/snap.

trends.title: New homeowner overwhelmed by maintenance and repair anxiety
trends.quote: Even small things feel huge sometimes, simply because of the anxiety about messing something up trying to do it ourselves or hugely expensive by getting someone else to do it.

trends.title: Clingy demanding cat driving owner insane
trends.quote: My cat is SO clingy and SO demanding and it drives me insane. She doesn't leave me alone for even a moment.
trends.decline_reason: Score 4.5/10 < 8.0 threshold. Existing skeletons: cat-aggression-handbook, why-does-my-cat-bite-me, kitten-bite-training-guide (overlap)
